title: Hypergraph Mining via Proximity Matrix
summary: Hypergraphs serve as an effective tool widely adopted to characterize higher-order interactions in complex systems. The most intuitive and commonly used mathematical instrument for representing a hypergraph is the incidence matrix, in which each entry is binary, indicating whether the corresponding node belongs to the corresponding hyperedge.
